# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-twenties by Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Rank:** Physician  <sub>[v4 c8 P10](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor  <sub>[v4 c8 P10](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Doctor  <sub>[v4 c6 P20](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0020)</sub>; Captain of the Freshman football team  <sub>[v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006)</sub>; Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, handsome youth with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes, and a broad-shouldered, athletic frame. As he matures into adulthood, he develops a straight, open face and a firm, manly chin. During his illness, he briefly appears pale and thin, but later regains his strength.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c19 P35](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0035), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P37](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0037)_

## Personality

Hugh is lively, intelligent, and mischievous during his school years, with a penchant for playful teasing and pranks. He possesses a strong sense of honor, ambition, and determination, striving to excel academically and professionally without harboring bitter malice. As an adult, he is a dedicated, compassionate, and brave physician who approaches life's duties and challenges with earnestness and integrity.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v4 c8 P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009)_

## History

Hugh grows up in Brierley, spending part of his early youth in Alberta before returning to attend Brierley school, where he becomes a top student and a friendly rival to Nell Harcourt. After finishing primary school, he teaches at Pale Sands to fund his education before attending Regent's Academy and Wexcombe College. He graduates with High Honors and the Cooper Prize, then completes his medical training. He begins his medical career at Seven Gulls Harbor by assisting his great-uncle, Dr. Dave Carrow. Though his early romantic overtures toward Nell are rejected, his steadfast devotion eventually wins her love. After surviving a severe bout of typhoid fever, he resumes his medical work and marries Nell at Grey Shutters. The couple settles in a small house near the harbor, where they welcome their first child, Little Kit, and build their lives together.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P10](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0010), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c28 P33](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0033), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c37 P30](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0030), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000), [v4 c8 P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009), [v4 c28 P33](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0033), [v4 c34 P2](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0002), [v4 c40 P7](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0007)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- Spent three years in Alberta during childhood with his father  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Attended primary school in Brierley and Regent's Academy in Port Marlow  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
